name: Android APK DEX reverse engineering and native JNI library analysis
topic: Android APK DEX reverse engineering and native JNI library analysis
description: Android APK DEX reverse engineering and native JNI library analysis -- a medium-tier reverse engineering challenge. Review the bundled artifacts, locate the encoded clue, decode it, and recover the flag. Flag format: pwn{...}
objectives: Inspect the challenge bundle for "Android APK DEX reverse engineering and native JNI library analysis"
Locate the encoded artifact (look in every shipped file)
Unwrap the encoding applied to the artifact
Recover the plaintext flag and submit it in pwn{...} format

hints.text: Start by inspecting every file in the bundle (hex dump, headers, magic bytes).
The artifact is wrapped in a non-text container -- use the right parser.
The artifact is base64. After decoding you have a 4-byte XOR cipher -- recover the key by crib-dragging against the known flag prefix.
